all_original_A_source_claims.complete_source_claim: Experiment generates two flickering noisy luminance square streams, residual luminance every13.33ms. Participants (N4) initially choose brighter option then may change response during 1.5sec continuation; inputs imposed World.
Experiment measured initial/final button decisions, initial/change timing and exact generated stimulus fluctuation trace; none is a direct observation of latent accumulation.
Original trial response change frequency23.91%, corrected error18.53%, spoilt correct5.38%; initial accuracy66.95% final accuracy80.10%, source descriptive behavior not model prediction.
Condition response by initially correct/error and later reversal; average moment-wise random stimulus residuals yields response-conditioned psychophysical kernels.
First sensory frame evidence strength associated with later reversal probability conditional on initial correctness chi-square42.08 p<8.75e-11.
Source initial-frame effect on reversal latency weaker but reported interaction chi-square4.27 p=.039; must retain effect-size/strength distinction.
Source pattern broadly source reported across N4 individual trials and two sensory directions but person-wise and rare-trial variation remains.

all_original_A_source_claims.complete_source_claim: Later pre-response mean evidence excluding first frame strongly predicts change likelihood chi-square192.36 and reversal speed82.36, both p≈2.2e-16; initial frame is not sole predictor.
In task 200–400ms mean sensory evidence beats 0–200ms for reversal likelihood AIC14961 vs15039; original later evidence can be stronger than earliest cue.

all_original_A_source_claims.complete_source_claim: Baseline extended DDM integrates noisy difference luminance until first decision bound and continues to opposite change-of-mind bound after first choice.

Baseline matched difficulty constant trial-wise drift + moment-wise noise gives fixed latent accumulator at first threshold conditional initial choice and therefore no source predicted first-frame dependence.

all_original_A_source_claims.original_locator: new original model Fig2 and native Methods
all_original_A_source_claims.complete_source_claim: Augmented extended DDM external stimulus-driven drift offset explicitly proportional to residual luminance FIRST FRAME, decreasing linearly with time; decaying snapshot biases continuing integration.

Separate independent INTERNAL/endogenous across-trial drift variability additively combines with external first-frame offset; original within-trial noise from external stimulus fluctuations and intrinsic random noise.

Latent decision variable accumulates ongoing sensory evidence and variable drift until first and optional reversed threshold crossing; response action lags and cannot be equated with latent boundary time.

all_original_A_source_claims.original_locator: source original fit Methods and S3
all_original_A_source_claims.complete_source_claim: Authors fit initial and changed response PROPORTIONS plus both RT QUANTILES simultaneously; source model psychophysical kernels are held-out predicted patterns rather than the direct fitted targets.
Simulate 100,000 MODEL trials for psychophysical kernel comparison after original behavioral fit, not 100,000 novel human empirical trials.
Preferred model with stimulus-linked external first-frame offset plus internal trial drift correctly qualitatively predicts actual first-frame behavioral reverse-correlation kernels.
Variant with IDENTICAL distribution trial-to-trial variability but DECOUPLED from initial stimulus predicts OPPOSITE early kernel direction, fails main source feature.
Original fixed across-trial drift variant predicts NO initial-frame early effect; apparent tiny fast/slow rare spoilt-correct simulation variations not reproducible real effects.

all_original_A_source_claims.original_locator: issuer S3 fitted model parameters and original Figure B
all_original_A_source_claims.complete_source_claim: Original variant parameters/model-prediction differences supplied in model S3; original parameter fits require exact published source constraints, not inference from plot resemblance.
Original first-frame mixed effects reflect conditional initial decision correctness and time effects, not first-frame deterministic causal proof.
Auxiliary average pre-response evidence excluding initial frame demonstrates continuing evidence contribution and contradicts first-frame-only decision dynamics.
Source trials where mean evidence favors incorrect response rare (~2.9%); aux source refutes simple mean-evidence confound claim on this rare subset without strong population-wide certainty.
Separate 1–200ms vs200–400ms GLMM early/late predictors nonnested fit and original parameters make late interval stronger in this specific paradigm.
Low-level luminance task with predictable onset and four heavily tested individuals; unknown generality with more temporally integrated or unpredictable stimuli.
Current decaying first-frame drift family is an extension of Resulaj 2009 extended DDM and prior Ratcliff 2008 DDM, not first invention of evidence accumulation.

Model latent z(t), decay and hidden endogenous drift are proposed System; external luminance samples and button press opportunities are World/Experiment; button movements/RT and stimulus kernels are measured observables; simulated kernels are estimates.
